top3.headline: Anthropic says one agent with skills often beats subagent teams
top3.whyItMatters: Simpler agent designs can cut cost and latency, so question multi-agent builds before funding them.

top3.headline: Anthropic token volume on OpenRouter jumped 3.6x since Opus 5.5
top3.whyItMatters: Model demand shifts within weeks, so avoid long lock-in to any single AI vendor.

top3.headline: Cerebras runs a 3-trillion-parameter open model at high speed
top3.whyItMatters: Frontier-size open models are becoming practical to serve, adding leverage in vendor talks.

items.title: US imports of AI hardware are outpacing US production
items.takeaway: Since 2019, computer imports rose 366% vs production 46%; grid equipment output fell 7% while imports rose 69%.
items.soWhat: The AI build-out leans on foreign hardware, so supply chains and tariffs shape your compute costs.

items.title: Anthropic token volume on OpenRouter is up 3.6x since Opus 5.5
items.takeaway: Carta's Peter Walker shared the 7-day average; it covers OpenRouter traffic across all Anthropic models only.
items.soWhat: Developer demand is shifting fast toward Anthropic, so keep model contracts flexible and benchmark alternatives often.

items.title: Musk says Grok can now phone businesses for you
items.takeaway: He says it makes the request, takes notes and sends a summary; no independent demo yet.
items.soWhat: Consumer agents are starting to call companies, so customer service lines may soon talk to bots.

items.title: Open-source security skills for coding agents gain large followings
items.takeaway: Cloudflare's audit skill has 46k GitHub stars; NVIDIA's SkillSpector scans agent skills for injection and exfiltration risks.
items.soWhat: Free tools now exist to audit agent skills, so require a scan before teams install third-party ones.

items.title: r/opensource bans projects that use or are made by AI
items.takeaway: New moderator rules say AI-made, AI-using or AI-targeted projects are not welcome.
items.soWhat: Some developer communities are pushing back on AI, which can limit reach for AI-built open-source work.

items.title: Anthropic: one agent with skills often beats a team of subagents
items.takeaway: Across enterprise deployments, a single loop often scored higher at lower cost; one customer ran about 2x faster.
items.soWhat: Agent designs that mirror the org chart add cost, so challenge each subagent before your teams build one.

items.title: Cerebras serves a 3-trillion-parameter open model across 59 wafers
items.takeaway: Using Kimi K3, it reports 1,000-2,000+ tokens per second by moving only activations between wafers.
items.soWhat: Fast serving of frontier-size open models is arriving, which widens your options beyond closed labs.

items.title: Study: AI-written text is harder for people to process
items.takeaway: All nine models studied used more rare phrases and odd subject-verb pairings than human writers.
items.soWhat: AI drafts may cost readers more effort, so edit for clarity before they reach customers or boards.
